title: Either / Or
notes:
This version is the 1st pressing
• Lightweight (115g-125g vinyl)
• Vinyl labels are pale yellow 
• Includes glossy insert with lyrics and credits
• Might still include KRS 1996 or 1997 mail order insert

Recorded at Joanna's house, my house, The Shop, Undercover Inc., Heatmiser house, and Laundry Rules
Mixed at The Shop and Undercover Inc. 
Mastered at Precision
